full_page.content:
1928., January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 4 Cont.
Jan. 11th Mrs. Jones. Widow !!! Mastoid cured over night! Rhumatism cured
Page 5
Genevieve Hurley - hopeless case paralysis in Fords - Bay City (Mrs. Lorian) 63. 2132 Mt. Elliott doctored 3 yrs. for tumor on liver - could not walk without great pain - Enrolled 2nd time in 3 months, now Quite improved
Jos Seger "Flying instead of in Mass on Sunday". falls 2000 feet shortly after enrollment on his 200th fly. Escaped with broken ankel. and other minor injuries.
#22000.00 spent for defective speech etc in son Wyandotte phone To-day
Dexter Boule'd Mr. Leonard Bowles 17 Shot through stomach on Thanksgiving day - accident Fearfully hopeless - now out of danger. Promised if spared would be baptised a Catholic and study for the priesthood
Page 6 I Cavanagh Case -.. Non C. Baker
II Helen Yaroch - Parlisis 3 yrs 19 yrs now - in perfect health till 12
III Mercier - 4 children 25 years blind in one eye two weeks ago in factory piece of brass flew into other eye
IV 9 years old helpless a not Cath. of Plymoth Wis.
V Letter from Italy
VI Marjory Fogerty - Fits.
Vii Young parylized since since 12 - now 25
Viii Mrs. Cath Corbey - Diabites
IX Young Mother in St. Josephs child-b.
